name: Utpaladeva (Utpalacarya)
summary: Founder of Pratyabhijna: IPK + Vrtti + lost Vivrti, Siddhitrayi theologian, Sivastotravali poet.
bio: Son and pupil of Udayakara-line (Udayakara's son, SomAnanda's pupil): the Isvarapratyabhijnakarika founds Pratyabhijna (recognition without effort), with auto-Vrtti and the lost long Vivrti (fragments via Torella/Ratie); Siddhitrayi theologian of the knower; Sivastotravali bhakti poet. Teacher in line to Abhinavagupta through Lakshmanagupta.
